integrity: An executable finite matching construction, directed Hasse acyclicity checks, independent face predicates, direct field boundary ranks, and literal execution output are included; not an external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact computation for the first forest-filtration stage of the Heawood graph only. No all-projective-planes formula, higher-level filtration classification, or equivariant result. Unindexed equivalent results remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Thirteen five-spheres in the first forest complex of the Fano-plane incidence graph
